PRO_MARA_001.text: Ugh... Still breathing. Radio... Nadiya? Elias? Anyone?
PRO_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

PRO_MARA_002.text: Right. Up. One step at a time.
PRO_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

PRO_MARA_003.text: This stone... it's vibrating. Not from seismic tremors. It's humming.
PRO_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

C01_MARA_001.text: Made it through the ridge. The expedition camp is just ahead.
C01_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The expedition camp is just ahead.

C01_NADIYA_001.text: You made it, Mara. Elias is waiting by the survey table.
C01_NADIYA_001.speaker: Nadiya

cues.text: Elias is waiting by the survey table.

C01_NADIYA_002.text: Get moving, Mara. The satellite pass was clear, but clouds are gathering.
C01_NADIYA_002.speaker: Nadiya

cues.text: The satellite pass was clear, but clouds are gathering.

C01_ELIAS_001.text: Mara! Look at the satellite telemetry on the table. We found a sub-ridge anomaly.
C01_ELIAS_001.speaker: Elias

cues.text: Look at the satellite telemetry on the table.

C01_ELIAS_002.text: Head up the eastern trail toward the waterfall gorge. Be careful on the rock ledges.
C01_ELIAS_002.speaker: Elias

cues.text: Head up the eastern trail toward the waterfall gorge.
Be careful on the rock ledges.

C01_MARA_002.text: Symmetrical subterranean chambers... That's not a natural fault. I'll check the eastern ridge.
C01_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

C01_MARA_003.text: Elias... I found it. A massive sealed stone doorway carved right into the mountain cliff.
C01_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

cues.text: A massive sealed stone doorway carved right into the mountain cliff.

C01_ELIAS_003.text: Incredible! Don't touch anything yet. I'm bringing Tomas and the equipment.
C01_ELIAS_003.speaker: Elias

cues.text: I'm bringing Tomas and the equipment.

C01_MARA_004.text: The carvings match the Vaelor texts... This is where it begins.
C01_MARA_004.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The carvings match the Vaelor texts...

C01_MARA_005.text: Field note. Waterfall chambers match the Vaelor survey. We document before we disturb.
C01_MARA_005.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Waterfall chambers match the Vaelor survey.

C01_TOMAS_001.text: Climbing kit is checked. If the weather turns, we come back together.
C01_TOMAS_001.speaker: Tomas

cues.text: If the weather turns, we come back together.

C01_ADRIAN_001.text: The eastern contour is verified. I will keep the survey beacon running.
C01_ADRIAN_001.speaker: Adrian

cues.text: I will keep the survey beacon running.

C02_MARA_001.text: The gate is locked by an ancient hydraulic counterweight. The water channel is blocked.
C02_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The gate is locked by an ancient hydraulic counterweight.

C02_MARA_002.text: Water's diverted into the conduit! The counterweight is filling.
C02_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

C02_MARA_003.text: The Voice Below..." It refers to a subterranean harmonic nexus deep in the mountain core.
C02_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The Voice Below..." It refers to a subterranean harmonic nexus deep in the mountain core.

C02_TOMAS_001.text: Mara, Elias is bringing the bridge rig across now!
C02_TOMAS_001.speaker: Tomas

cues.text: Mara, Elias is bringing the bridge rig across now!

C02_MARA_004.text: The inscription says the stone listens. These chambers carry sound like roads carry people.
C02_MARA_004.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The inscription says the stone listens.
These chambers carry sound like roads carry people.

C03_ELIAS_001.text: Mara, take the center line! The stone anchors look brittle.
C03_ELIAS_001.speaker: Elias

C03_MARA_001.text: The anchors are giving way! JUMP!
C03_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

C03_MARA_003.text: The bridge was built to move with the mountain. Someone cut its safety anchors.
C03_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The bridge was built to move with the mountain.

C04_MARA_001.text: Underground... Water broke my fall. I need to find high ground and radio contact.
C04_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: I need to find high ground and radio contact.

C04_NADIYA_001.text: Mara? Oh, thank God. Listen to me. Meridian contractors are in the valley. Armed.
C04_NADIYA_001.speaker: Nadiya

cues.text: Meridian contractors are in the valley.

C04_MARA_002.text: Voices ahead... Flashlights in the darkness. Meridian is here.
C04_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

C04_MARA_003.text: An old survey camp. They found this passage a century ago, then turned back.
C04_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

cues.text: They found this passage a century ago, then turned back.

C05_MARA_001.text: Meridian. Armed, and standing between me and the water. Stay low.
C05_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Armed, and standing between me and the water.

C05_DRAKE_001.text: Vale's team found the door. Secure the subterranean aqueduct immediately.
C05_DRAKE_001.speaker: Drake

C05_MARA_002.text: Water's rushing into the temple basin. Time to dive.
C05_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Water's rushing into the temple basin.

C05_MARA_003.text: Meridian crates. This was planned before we opened the portal. Someone gave them our route.
C05_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

cues.text: This was planned before we opened the portal.

C05_MERIDIAN_001.text: Hold the lower passage. No one enters without clearance.
C05_MERIDIAN_001.speaker: Meridian

C06_MARA_001.text: The temple is half-submerged. I need to drain the central basin to reach the inner sanctum.
C06_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: I need to drain the central basin to reach the inner sanctum.

C06_MARA_002.text: The aqueduct is flushing out! The lower gate is emerging from the water.
C06_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The lower gate is emerging from the water.

C06_MARA_003.text: Nadiya... there's a city down here. An entire city.
C06_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

C06_MARA_004.text: The temple's water channels regulate pressure. The flood is damage, not a trap.
C06_MARA_004.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The temple's water channels regulate pressure.
The flood is damage, not a trap.

C07_MARA_001.text: They built a city under the mountain. And every stone is still listening.
C07_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: They built a city under the mountain.
And every stone is still listening.

C07_MARA_002.text: They knew the Vault was unstable... but they kept using it because it worked. Until it didn't.
C07_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

cues.text: They knew the Vault was unstable...
but they kept using it because it worked.

C07_MARA_003.text: A tomb sealed with counterweights. They engineered even their grief.
C07_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

C07_TOMAS_001.text: Mara, we're holding position at the forward camp! Hurry!
C07_TOMAS_001.speaker: Tomas

cues.text: Mara, we're holding position at the forward camp!

C07_MARA_004.text: They left the warning where everyone could see it. We should listen to the people who lived here.
C07_MARA_004.speaker: Mara

cues.text: They left the warning where everyone could see it.
We should listen to the people who lived here.

C08_MARA_001.text: I see expedition gear ahead! Elias, Nadiya!
C08_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

C08_ELIAS_001.text: Mara... Adrian took the Vaelor Key. He's been transmitting coordinates to Meridian all along.
C08_ELIAS_001.speaker: Elias

cues.text: He's been transmitting coordinates to Meridian all along.

C08_ADRIAN_001.text: I'm sorry, Mara. I sold the coordinates, not your lives. Drake took the Key. Use the service road.
C08_ADRIAN_001.speaker: Adrian

cues.text: I sold the coordinates, not your lives.

C08_MARA_002.text: Elias trusted Adrian's survey. So did I. Trust is not proof; the transmission log is.
C08_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Trust is not proof; the transmission log is.

C08_MARA_003.text: You gave him the way in. Help us get everyone out.
C08_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

cues.text: You gave him the way in.

C08_ELIAS_002.text: The Key opens the Vault, Mara. The four outer nodes can still stop it.
C08_ELIAS_002.speaker: Elias

cues.text: The Key opens the Vault, Mara.
The four outer nodes can still stop it.

C09_MARA_001.text: Drake's charges are shaking the conduits loose. The whole mountain feels it.
C09_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Drake's charges are shaking the conduits loose.

C09_MARA_003.text: This is it. The threshold of the Heart Vault. Drake is inside.
C09_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The threshold of the Heart Vault.

C09_MARA_004.text: The Heart Road carries the city's resonance. Every blast travels farther than they know.
C09_MARA_004.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The Heart Road carries the city's resonance.
Every blast travels farther than they know.

C10_MARA_001.text: The Heart Vault... The resonance in this chamber is deafening. There's Drake.
C10_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The resonance in this chamber is deafening.

C10_DRAKE_001.text: Hear that, Vale? Every fault line on Earth, waiting for a conductor.
C10_DRAKE_001.speaker: Drake

cues.text: Every fault line on Earth, waiting for a conductor.

C10_DRAKE_002.text: No! What did you do?! The feedback is tearing the platform apart!
C10_DRAKE_002.speaker: Drake

cues.text: The feedback is tearing the platform apart!

C10_MARA_003.text: Drake, get out! It's over! RUN!
C10_MARA_003.speaker: Mara

C10_MARA_004.text: Four nodes hold the network in balance. Break the feedback, and Drake loses the core.
C10_MARA_004.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Four nodes hold the network in balance.
Break the feedback, and Drake loses the core.

C10_MARA_005.text: The Vaelor sealed this place for a reason. You are repeating their mistake.
C10_MARA_005.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The Vaelor sealed this place for a reason.

C10_DRAKE_003.text: They lacked control. We have the instruments to finish what they began.
C10_DRAKE_003.speaker: Drake

cues.text: We have the instruments to finish what they began.

FIN_MARA_001.text: I see daylight! Tomas, Nadiya, I'm almost through the eastern fissure!
FIN_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Tomas, Nadiya, I'm almost through the eastern fissure!

FIN_TOMAS_001.text: Mara! Grab my hand! I've got you!
FIN_TOMAS_001.speaker: Tomas

FIN_MARA_002.text: We leave the core here. No one gets to turn their history into a weapon.
FIN_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

cues.text: No one gets to turn their history into a weapon.

FIN_NADIYA_001.text: Elias is clear. Tomas, get her away from the edge!
FIN_NADIYA_001.speaker: Nadiya

cues.text: Tomas, get her away from the edge!

EPI_ELIAS_001.text: We came looking for a discovery. You reminded us what we owe it.
EPI_ELIAS_001.speaker: Elias

cues.text: We came looking for a discovery.
You reminded us what we owe it.

EPI_MARA_001.text: The survey will prove the site exists. Its location stays protected.
EPI_MARA_001.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The survey will prove the site exists.

EPI_MARA_002.text: Some stories survive because we leave them where they belong.
EPI_MARA_002.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Some stories survive because we leave them where they belong.

REC_PRO.text: I woke beneath the mountain with a dead radio and a glyph that hummed under my hand. To understand how I got there, I have to go back three days.
REC_PRO.speaker: Mara

cues.text: I woke beneath the mountain with a dead radio and a glyph that hummed under my hand.
To understand how I got there, I have to go back three days.

REC_C01.text: We reached camp under gathering cloud. The survey showed chambers too symmetrical to be natural, and on the eastern ridge I found a sealed Vaelor door.
REC_C01.speaker: Mara

cues.text: We reached camp under gathering cloud.
The survey showed chambers too symmetrical to be natural, and on the eastern ridge I found a sealed Vaelor door.

REC_C02.text: Water opened the first ruin, and its inscription named the Voice Below. This stone was built to carry sound the way roads carry people.
REC_C02.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Water opened the first ruin, and its inscription named the Voice Below.
This stone was built to carry sound the way roads carry people.

REC_C03.text: The bridge gave way, and I fell alone into the fissure. Its anchors hadn't failed. Someone had cut them.
REC_C03.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The bridge gave way, and I fell alone into the fissure.

REC_C04.text: I followed air and water through the dark and got the radio working. Nadiya's warning came too late. Meridian was already below.
REC_C04.speaker: Mara

cues.text: I followed air and water through the dark and got the radio working.

REC_C05.text: I slipped past Lucian Drake's patrols. Their crates proved one thing: someone gave them our route before we ever opened the door.
REC_C05.speaker: Mara

cues.text: I slipped past Lucian Drake's patrols.
Their crates proved one thing: someone gave them our route before we ever opened the door.

REC_C06.text: I drained the drowned temple, and the lower gate rose out of the water. Beyond it was a city no one had seen in centuries.
REC_C06.speaker: Mara

cues.text: I drained the drowned temple, and the lower gate rose out of the water.
Beyond it was a city no one had seen in centuries.

REC_C07.text: The City of Echoes left its warning on the walls: the Vault worked, until it didn't. Then Tomas called. The team was waiting.
REC_C07.speaker: Mara

cues.text: The City of Echoes left its warning on the walls: the Vault worked, until it didn't.

REC_C08.text: Elias was hurt, and the Key was gone. Adrian sold our coordinates to Meridian, and now Drake holds the way into the Vault.
REC_C08.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Elias was hurt, and the Key was gone.
Adrian sold our coordinates to Meridian, and now Drake holds the way into the Vault.

REC_C09.text: Drake's charges tore the Heart Road apart around me. I reached the Vault threshold with the mountain shaking at my back.
REC_C09.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Drake's charges tore the Heart Road apart around me.
I reached the Vault threshold with the mountain shaking at my back.

REC_C10.text: I broke the four nodes, and the feedback tore the Vault out of Drake's hands. Then the chamber began to seal, and I ran.
REC_C10.speaker: Mara

cues.text: I broke the four nodes, and the feedback tore the Vault out of Drake's hands.
Then the chamber began to seal, and I ran.

REC_FIN.text: Tomas pulled me onto the ridge as the mountain closed behind us. Everyone made it out. The Vault stays buried.
REC_FIN.speaker: Mara

cues.text: Tomas pulled me onto the ridge as the mountain closed behind us.
